entities.name: Elliott Woolfolk Major
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Elliott Woolfolk Major was an American lawyer and progressive Democratic politician from Pike County, Missouri, who served as the 25th Attorney General of Missouri and the 33rd Governor of Missouri.
